label: Some receipt with correlativity is concurrent actualization, checked (inference)
rule: Forward: compose the present-tense reading with correlativity; backward: take the standing-composition receipt
meaning: Closed result with no premises, quantified over every history, giving relation and reception predicate. If some receipt interpretation satisfies the present-tense reading and correlativity, then weak concurrent actualization 40a97664 holds (the derivation 7c62adb5). Conversely, if 40a97664 holds, the standing-composition receipt (RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_2) satisfies the present-tense reading by definition and correlativity by standingReadingIsTheCrux. So the present-receipt pair adds nothing to 40a97664 unless the receipt relation is fixed by a reading that carries further content; the separation in Control part 3 holds only for a fixed interpretation. It establishes nothing about reality.
